The skin pinch returns to normal, and the eyes are not sunken. There is no blood in the stool. The child is not restless or irritable. The child has not had convulsions and is not convulsing now. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child does not vomit everything. There is no cough or difficulty in breathing. The child does not have an ear problem. The child does not have fever.
